sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Egg Car Travel is a timing-based puzzle game. Your objective is to navigate the egg across a series of levels, each with its own unique obstacles and challenges. The game's controls are incredibly simple, with just two buttons required to play: the left and right arrow keys (or the corresponding buttons on your touch device). The twist is that you need to tap the left arrow key to reverse your movement, adding a whole new layer of complexity to the game. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter increasingly difficult obstacles, from moving platforms to treacherous terrain. But don't worry – with practice, you'll develop the skills and reflexes needed to overcome even the toughest challenges.
